title.en: Keep Today’s Sprint aligned with the selected Play language
title.zh: 让今日速成始终跟随 Play 已选语言

purpose.en: Prevent a stale Today’s Sprint language after a learner changes the target language from the production Play picker.
purpose.zh: 防止学习者在正式站 Play 选择器切换目标语言后，今日速成仍保留旧语言。

en: Synchronize the Sprint dialog selection whenever the Play page target-language parameter changes.
Preserve the explicit learner choice made inside an already-open Sprint dialog.
zh: Play 页面目标语言参数变化时同步速成弹窗选项。
保留学习者在已打开速成弹窗内作出的明确语言选择。

en: Today’s Sprint dialog and start link
zh: 中文界面 Play 语言选择器
今日速成弹窗与启动链接

en: Derive the active Sprint selection from the latest Play target while preserving an explicit choice made for that same target.
Add a regression contract requiring the derived synchronization behavior.
zh: 从最新 Play 目标派生当前速成语言，同时保留学习者针对同一目标作出的明确选择。
增加要求该派生同步行为的回归契约。

en: Run the complete repository release gate and all routed shared-site policy gates.
Reproduce the stale Japanese selection before the fix and retest the same Play-to-Sprint path in production Chrome after deployment.
Verify the selected language, five-minute start URL, Sprint course title, and persisted result agree.
zh: 运行完整仓库发布门禁及所有已路由共享站点政策门禁。
修复前复现日语选择滞留，并在部署后用正式站 Chrome 复测同一 Play 到速成路径。
核验已选语言、5 分钟启动 URL、速成课程标题与持久化结果一致。

en: Real microphone scoring remains dependent on the local Chrome device capability and is reported separately by the 21-day QA run.
zh: 真实麦克风评分仍取决于本机 Chrome 设备能力，并由 21 天 QA 运行单独报告。

en: The fix is limited to SmartLingo’s target-language-aware Play and Today’s Sprint flow; interface locale and course identifiers remain site-local.
zh: 修复仅限 SmartLingo 的目标语言感知 Play 与今日速成流程；界面语言和课程标识仍保持站点本地化。
